subject: Final acceptance gate, procurement tie-ins, and start date coordination
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@apollotech.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: lisa.huang@apollotech.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + timing: final go/no-go and paperwork windows

Vanessa / Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo this week. Attached is our updated mutual action plan (MAP_v3) with the evaluation criteria and milestone dates. Two asks so we can lock the procurement calendar on our side:

- Final go/no-go target (we'd like a single day decision so our legal/IT can coordinate the PO routing)
- Signature window options and earliest feasible start date (we prefer early May but can be flexible)

High-level constraints on our side:
- Security questionnaire needs a final thumbs-up from IT by Apr 20
- Procurement will route PO once they see a firm start date and SOW

Can you confirm the internal owners for approvals and the latest possible date you can commit to for the go/no-go? If helpful, we can push our procurement deadline by 48 hours but would prefer to avoid that.

Attachments: ApolloTech_MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_v1.2.docx

Carlos
Senior Product Manager | ApolloTech
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@apollotech.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timing: final go/no-go and paperwork windows

Carlos — thanks for the MAP and call notes. Quick summary of our proposed operational plan so procurement can slot the PO routing: 

1) Internal owners and deliverables:
   - Van: program lead (final go/no-go, comms) — vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
   - Raf: commercial approval (pricing/discounts) — rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
   - Kim: legal redlines and SOW finalization — kimberly_park@redwood.ai
   - Sean: onboarding SLA/start-date coordination — sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

2) Proposed timing (please confirm if these work for ApolloTech):
   - Legal redline cutoff: 2027-04-16 EOD (Kim to circulate redlines)
   - Commercial signoff / go-no-go: 2027-04-17 by 5pm PT (single day decision we can communicate to ops)
   - Signature window (DocuSign ready): 2027-04-19 to 2027-04-20 (standard 48-hour signer window)
   - Target platform start date: 2027-05-01 (we can shift to 2027-05-03 if procurement needs weekend buffers)

3) Dependencies we need from you:
   - Final security questionnaire answers (or confirm outstanding items) by 2027-04-20
   - PO owner and remit details so finance can pre-pop the invoice

We will prepare the final SOW version with the start date placeholder and route it through DocuSign as soon as legal confirms redlines. If the 17th for go/no-go is too tight, propose an alternative single date (we prefer no more than 2 business days slip).

I will attach a one-page close-playbook (ops checklist) to the DocuSign envelope so both teams have the runbook for commissioning.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@apollotech.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timing: final go/no-go and paperwork windows

Looping in briefly — we can commit to the 4/17 go/no-go as long as Finance signs off on the deal economics tomorrow morning. Kim, can you confirm legal can get the redlines back by EOD today? If there are material changes to liability/retention we need to see them by noon PT so we can make a pricing call.

Action items for clarity:
- Kim: finalize redline pass (target 2027-04-16 EOD)
- Vanessa: prepare DocuSign envelope and Ops runbook (I will approve routing once legal clears)
- Finance: Lori (cc'd on internal thread) to confirm PO processing timeline

If anything blocks the 4/17 signoff, we push to 4/19 but that requires a quick 24-hour expedite from procurement. Rafa

Rafael Mendes
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@apollotech.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@apollotech.com>, procurement@apollotech.com
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timing: final go/no-go and paperwork windows

Thanks — confirmation from procurement side: we will route the PO and internal approvals to Legal by 2027-04-18. A couple notes from our side:

- We prefer a start date of 2027-05-03 (gives us a payroll/weekend buffer) — if Redwood can accommodate that in the SOW, we will sign on the 4/19–4/20 window.
- Please include invoice remit and Redwood tax ID on the SOW so procurement can pre-pop the PO numbers.
- We will provide remaining security questionnaire clarifications by 2027-04-20 EOD.

Attachments: None (will attach PO form after internal approval).

Lisa Huang
Head of Procurement | ApolloTech
